column1: # Module 10 — AI security taster. Format: Question¶{{c1::complete answer}}<TAB>tags. Back Extra stays empty. Card law: anki/CARD-RULES.md
What is prompt injection, in one sentence?¶{{c1::Text the model reads as DATA gets obeyed as INSTRUCTIONS — everything in context is tokens with no trust label}}

What is direct vs indirect prompt injection, and which is dangerous for agents?¶Direct = {{c1::typed by the user}}; indirect = {{c1::planted in content the agent reads (documents/email/web/repo files)}}; dangerous one = {{c1::indirect}}
What are the five prompt-injection families?¶{{c1::Direct override}} · {{c1::role-play framing}} · {{c1::encoding tricks}} · {{c1::output-channel abuse}} · {{c1::indirect (planted content)}}
What is Willison's lethal trifecta?¶{{c1::Private data}} + {{c1::untrusted content}} + {{c1::external comms}} — {{c1::all three present means one poisoned document can exfiltrate}}
Why can't prompt hardening fix the lethal trifecta?¶{{c1::The model can't reliably distinguish injected instructions from data — the mixing IS the vulnerability}}
In the OWASP LLM Top 10, what is LLM01?¶{{c1::Prompt injection}}
In the OWASP LLM Top 10, what is LLM02?¶{{c1::Sensitive information disclosure}}
In the OWASP LLM Top 10, what is LLM03?¶{{c1::Supply chain — models, packages, and the skills/agents you install}}
In the OWASP LLM Top 10, what is LLM05?¶{{c1::Improper output handling — model output executed without review}}
In the OWASP LLM Top 10, what is LLM06?¶{{c1::Excessive agency — capability beyond the task's contract}}
In the OWASP LLM Top 10, what is LLM07?¶{{c1::System prompt leakage — assume CLAUDE.md and skills are extractable}}
In the OWASP LLM Top 10, what is LLM09?¶{{c1::Misinformation — confident wrong output acted upon}}
In the OWASP LLM Top 10, what is LLM10?¶{{c1::Unbounded consumption — runaway loops, quota/cost burn}}
Which two LLM defences survive a smart attacker?¶{{c1::Capability narrowing}} · {{c1::human gates on irreversible acts}} — {{c1::both architectural, not prompting}}
Why are input/output filters only speed bumps?¶{{c1::Paraphrase and encoding defeat them — they judge strings, not intent}}
What was your estate's own excessive-agency finding?¶{{c1::ClaudeBridgeWorker pushed the WHOLE repo every ~5 min though its contract was machines/context/ — flattened a merge commit (ledger 108)}}
What does bypassPermissions remove, and what becomes the dominant risk?¶Removes {{c1::the last human gate between model output and the machine}}; dominant risks become {{c1::LLM05/LLM06}}
Which connector is the classic untrusted-content leg?¶{{c1::Email — anyone who can email you can place text in a session's context}}
What is the threat-model question set?¶{{c1::What could go wrong}} · {{c1::who could cause it}} · {{c1::what stops it today}} · {{c1::cheapest control that would actually help}}
A control you'd never tolerate is what?¶{{c1::Not a control — it's a wish (the honesty column in the per-asset table)}}
